wargear.name: Iron Hand graft
wargear.summary: A fist and forearm of black-iron servos, grafted on in a ritual of surrender.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with an Iron Hand graft adds 1 to its Strength Characteristic and subtracts 1 from its Initiative Characteristic.

wargear.name: Fortress-shield array
wargear.summary: Interlocked shield plates and a gyro-stabilised brace turn the squad into a moving bulkhead.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Fortress-shield array, all Models in that Unit have an Invulnerable Save of 4+, unless they already have a better Invulnerable Save. If the Model carrying the array is removed as a casualty, the bonus is lost.

wargear.name: Pain-engine harness
wargear.summary: A cortex-fed servitor harness that turns every wound into fuel for the next blow.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Pain-engine harness adds 1 to its Attacks Characteristic and subtracts 1 from its Initiative Characteristic.

wargear.name: Clan iron-cladding
wargear.summary: Layer upon layer of clan-forged plating bolted over the sarcophagus.
wargear.text: A Walker equipped with Clan iron-cladding adds 1 to its Wounds Characteristic.

wargear.name: Cortex-link relay
wargear.summary: A mast-mounted relay that shares aiming data between brothers.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Cortex-link relay has the Linked Targeting Special Rule.

wargear.name: Magnetic clamps
wargear.summary: Boots that lock to any deck or plate.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with Magnetic clamps, all Models in that Unit have the Anchored Special Rule. If the Model carrying the clamps is removed as a casualty, the bonus is lost.

wargear.name: Servo-arm array
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Servo-arm array has the Servo Grapple Special Rule.

wargear.name: Spall slabs
wargear.summary: Slab plates bolted over the glacis.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with Spall slabs has the Slab Plating Special Rule.

wargear.name: Hair-trigger cortex
wargear.summary: A machine-spirit core tuned to lash out the moment something moves.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Hair-trigger cortex has the Cogitator Overwatch Special Rule.

wargear.name: Dozer ram-plate
wargear.summary: A dozer plate forged for clearing barricades.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with a Dozer ram-plate has the Plough Through Special Rule.

wargear.name: Warp-dead rod
wargear.summary: A rod threaded with warp-dead iron.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Warp-dead rod has the Warp-Dead Field Special Rule.

wargear.name: Clan-fall banner
wargear.summary: The banner of a clan that was cut down.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Clan-fall banner, all Models in that Unit have the Oath of the Clan Remnant Special Rule. If the Model carrying the banner is removed as a casualty, the bonus is lost.

wargear.name: Lodestone of Medusa
wargear.summary: A fist-sized knot of magnetised ore from the Medusan peaks, still pulling.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with the Lodestone of Medusa has the Magnetic Dominion Special Rule.

rules.name: Cortex-Locked
rules.summary: The Iron Father's cold commands leave no room for hesitation.
rules.text: While an Iron Father is on the table, a Unit with this Special Rule cannot gain the Pinned or Suppressed Tactical Status.

rules.name: Unyielding Wall
rules.summary: Set the line, lock the plates, and let the enemy come.
rules.text: If a Unit with this Special Rule did not move during its Controlling Player's most recent Movement phase, its Models improve their Save Characteristic by 1, to a best of 2+, against Shooting Attacks.

rules.name: Hammerfall
rules.summary: The Gorgon's chosen strike like a falling mountain.
rules.text: In a Battle Turn in which a Unit with this Special Rule makes a Charge, its Models add 1 to their Strength Characteristic. If the Unit destroys the Unit it charged, it may make a Set-up Move of up to 3".

rules.name: Linked Targeting
rules.summary: One brother's sight is every brother's sight.
rules.text: When a friendly Iron Hands Unit within 6" of a Model with this Special Rule makes a Shooting Attack against the same target as that Model's Unit, its Hit Tests against that target are made with a +1 modifier.

rules.name: Anchored
rules.summary: Locked to the deck, they cannot be shifted.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule ignores the effects of the Pinning (X) Special Rule and cannot be moved by any effect that pushes or displaces it. A Unit with this Special Rule cannot Rush.

rules.name: Servo Grapple
rules.summary: The servos clamp on and do not let go.
rules.text: At the start of each Assault, the Controlling Player chooses one enemy Model in base contact with a Model with this Special Rule. That Model subtracts 1 from its Weapon Skill Characteristic for that Assault.

rules.name: Slab Plating
rules.summary: Thick plate takes the sting from head-on fire.
rules.text: The AP of each Shooting Attack that hits the front of a Vehicle with this Special Rule is worsened by 1 (for example, AP 3 becomes AP 4), to a worst of AP 6. A Shooting Attack with no AP is unaffected.

rules.name: Cogitator Overwatch
rules.summary: The cortex fires the instant a target steps into its arc.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule makes Reaction Shooting Attacks using its full Ballistic Skill instead of making Snap Shots.

rules.name: Plough Through
rules.summary: Barricades are only a delay, and what stands behind them is shoved aside.
rules.text: A Vehicle with this Special Rule ignores Difficult Terrain. Each enemy Unit that it Rams gains the Pinned Tactical Status.

rules.name: Warp-Dead Field
rules.summary: The rod drinks the warp and gives nothing back.
rules.text: Psychic Checks made for enemy psychic powers used within 6" of a Model with this Special Rule are made with a -1 modifier. Each enemy Psyker within 6" of that Model subtracts 1 from its Willpower Characteristic.

rules.name: Oath of the Clan Remnant
rules.summary: The clan is gone. The oath is not.
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of its Controlling Player's Battle Turn, a Unit with this Special Rule may remove one Tactical Status it has.

rules.name: The Gorgon Unleashed
rules.summary: The Gorgon stops being a commander and becomes a force of nature.
rules.text: This Model adds 1 to its Strength Characteristic and subtracts 2 from its Initiative Characteristic, and it cannot make Reactions. Whenever a Combat that includes this Model is won by its side, every enemy Unit in that Combat gains the Suppressed Tactical Status.

rules.name: Smith of Ruin
rules.summary: He knows how every machine is built, and so where it breaks.
rules.text: Weapons carried by this Model have the Armourbane Special Rule, and Wound Tests made for its attacks against a Model with the Vehicle, Walker or Automata Type are made with a +1 modifier. This Model cannot use the Battlesmith (X) Special Rule and subtracts 1 from its Ballistic Skill Characteristic.

rules.name: Father of the Clans
rules.summary: He is their founder and their judge, and they hold the line to be seen holding it.
rules.text: Friendly Iron Hands Units within 9" of this Model add 1 to their Leadership Characteristic. This Model subtracts 2 from its Movement Characteristic and cannot Rush.

rules.name: Magnetic Dominion
rules.summary: Every machine near him is dragged half a degree off true.
rules.text: Enemy Models with the Vehicle, Walker or Automata Type that are Engaged with a Model with this Special Rule subtract 2 from their Initiative Characteristic. Hit Tests made by such enemy Models for Shooting Attacks against a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule are made with a -1 modifier.

rules.name: Rivet-Bound
rules.summary: A rivet driven through the greave is a promise the target will keep.
rules.text: An enemy Unit that suffers one or more Unsaved Wounds from a Shooting Attack made with the Clan-oath rivet-gun subtracts 2 from its Movement Characteristic until the end of its Controlling Player's next Battle Turn.

rites.name: Cohorts of the Iron Father
rites.flavor: A Clan-Council that trusts steel and cortex-code over the whims of flesh.
benefits: Castellax Battle Maniples and Castellax Destructor Maniples may fill Troops slots.
Every Castellax gains +1 Ballistic Skill and Cortex-Locked: it cannot gain the Pinned or Suppressed Tactical Status while an Iron Father is on the table.
limitations: An Iron Father (either pattern) must be in the army.
No more than two Tactical or Despoiler Squads in total.
No Librarians or Esoterists, no Assault Squads, and no model with the Antigrav type.

modifiers.text: Cohorts of the Iron Father: +1 BS, Cortex-Locked.

require.note: An Iron Father must command the cohorts.

rites.name: Wall of Black Iron
rites.flavor: Nothing in the Legion is built to retreat, and the Immortals least of all.
benefits: Gorgon Terminator Squads may fill Troops slots.
Medusan Immortals Squads gain Line (1) and Unyielding Wall: they improve their Save Characteristic by 1 (to a best of 2+) against Shooting Attacks in any turn they did not move.
limitations: At least two Medusan Immortals Squads are required.
No Fast Attack units and no Recon units.

modifiers.text: Wall of Black Iron: Line (1), Unyielding Wall.

require.note: Bring at least two Medusan Immortals Squads.

rites.name: The Gorgon's Hammer
rites.flavor: When the clan-lords stop talking, the Gorgons go in.
benefits: Gorgon Terminator Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain Hammerfall: +1 Strength on a turn they charge, and a Set-up Move of up to 3" after destroying the Unit they charged.
limitations: At least two Gorgon Terminator Squads are required.
No Armour units and no Recon units.

require.note: Bring at least two Gorgon Terminator Squads.

armyRules.name: Cold Logic
armyRules.flavor: Flesh is weak, and so is fear.
benefits: A Unit with this Special Rule ignores the effects of the Pinned Tactical Status.
drawbacks: A Unit with this Special Rule subtracts 1 from the result of its Charge Rolls.

armyRules.name: Grudge-Ledger
armyRules.flavor: The Clans record every wound taken and repay it.
benefits: Once an enemy Unit has destroyed a Model in a Unit with this Special Rule, Hit Tests made by that Unit against that enemy Unit are made with a +1 modifier for the rest of the battle.
drawbacks: Until the enemy Unit is destroyed, a Unit with this Special Rule must choose it as the target of its Shooting Attacks if it can see it.

armyRules.name: Cortex-Net Hub
armyRules.flavor: A commander wired into the Legion's battle-net.
benefits: Friendly Iron Hands Units within 9" of a Model with this Special Rule do not gain the Suppressed Tactical Status from Shooting Attacks.
drawbacks: If a Model with this Special Rule is removed as a casualty, each friendly Iron Hands Unit that was within 9" of it gains the Suppressed Tactical Status.

armyRules.name: Clans Behind the Gorgon
armyRules.flavor: The Clans stand harder with the Gorgon's eye on them, and not one wishes to be seen to break.
benefits: While Ferrus Manus is on the battlefield, friendly Iron Hands Infantry Models within 12" of him add 1 to their Weapon Skill Characteristic in any Assault phase in which their Unit was the target of an enemy Charge.
drawbacks: A friendly Iron Hands Unit within 12" of Ferrus Manus cannot voluntarily Fall Back.
If Ferrus Manus is removed as a casualty, every friendly Iron Hands Unit subtracts 1 from its Leadership Characteristic and 1 from its Cool Characteristic for the remainder of the battle.
armyRules.condition: when charged, within 12" of Ferrus Manus
